net.guizhanss.fastmachines.core.services

Class LocalizationService

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.guizhanss.fastmachines.libs.guizhanlib.localization.Localization
      • net.guizhanss.fastmachines.core.services.LocalizationService

  • public class LocalizationService
extends Localization
    Reimplemented against the fork's own SlimefunItemStack/SlimefunUtils rather than GuizhanLib's SlimefunLocalization: that upstream class's item helpers return the pre-fork package's SlimefunItemStack, a type this fork's renamed API no longer has.

        An item-group icon: pure decoration, never a registered item.
        Implementation Note:
        Deliberately NOT a SlimefunItemStack: that type always overwrites the display name with the raw id, so the category rendered as "FM_FAST_MACHINES" in the guide.
